g.text: Libo: displacement vs. missing expected support
0–6 s; same retained trials. One farthest-from-median complete point omitted per group; pale bars: sample SD.
One sample = one foot at one 10 ms snapshot. Lines follow increasing height; expected-support totals differ by wave.
